scope.claim: endpoint-native discovery and certification only; downstream measurement is a non-frozen blueprint

scan.pilot_exclusion: retain every hit, but exclude all 272 bottom-child orbits whose recovered parent orbit is the pilot parent

sampling_prp.description: keyed modeled PRP; not a cryptographically proven PRP
sampling_prp.construction: 12-round alternating 26/25-bit Feistel with mix64 round function
sampling_prp.sampling_model: conditional on ideal-PRP exchangeability, the first 3.6e9 outputs are an ordered sample without replacement from nonzero coefficients

population_model.quota_probability_method: Binomial(2369,p) approximation using the exact without-replacement marginal parent-hit probability; parent indicators modeled independent
population_model.qualification: all inclusion quantities and the quota approximation are conditional on the keyed modeled-PRP exchangeability model

selection.rule: first 32 eligible distinct parent orbits in global-index order; retain the first bottom child for each parent
eligible_requires: parent orbit outside the complete pilot parent fiber
selection.failure_rule: an unresolved or admitted failure at or before the provisional 32nd eligible global rank invalidates the run; when fewer than 32 are recovered, any admitted failure invalidates it
selection.duplicate_policy: retain exact-b, bottom-sibling, and parent-orbit duplicates and all failures; duplicates never consume quota
selection.direct_parent_policy: retain and skip only after two independent order-271 x-only points positively certify full rank

classifier.kernel_rationality: x(T)^q=x([u]T) for a serialized u in 1..135 and the Velu half-kernel sum is q-fixed
classifier.target_certificate: two order-271 x-only points; enumerate all 135 x-coordinates of the first cyclic subgroup and prove the second absent

controls.negative: crater, all 16 f=271 representatives, and normal-mode pilot exclusion
positive: f=271 floor to crater with order-271^2 witness
pilot bottom to its frozen parent with order-271^2 witness

downstream_native_measurement.status: NON-FROZEN BLUEPRINT ONLY; no benchmark estimator, schedule, seed, test family, or performance claim is admitted by this discovery freeze; a separate rho protocol must freeze them after discovery and before timing
downstream_native_measurement.f271_assignment: complete 16-orbit crossover within every deep pair: six inferential and two held-out blocks per f=271 representative

conjugate_balancing.parent_bottom: within each deep pair, the 96 P/B assignments contain a random/permuted 0..50 schedule followed by 45 duplicated conjugates; P and B use the same conjugate in a block to preserve the edge
conjugate_balancing.f271: conjugates are near-balanced over pair by six-assignment cells
conjugate_balancing.analysis_weighting: calibrate cell means to equal model weight
conjugate_balancing.freeze_obligation: freeze the exact permutation, duplicated-conjugate choices, and seeds in the separate benchmark protocol before endpoint outcomes

downstream_native_measurement.point_policy: independently construct P and Q natively on every curve; no transported points
downstream_native_measurement.primary_metric: bits of ratio of arithmetic mean walk_ops
downstream_native_measurement.adjacency_qualification: these are conductor-order lattice level associations; only the sampled P-B pair is a certified matched degree-271 edge in this discovery, while crossed C-P and A-B arms are not supplied as explicit matched isogeny edges
downstream_native_measurement.selected_32_estimand: hold pair strata fixed and resample 96 target blocks within pair
downstream_native_measurement.whole_level_estimand: conditional on the modeled-PRP/exchangeability sampling model, resample the 32 edge-pair PSUs then target blocks; any level claim is restricted to the pilot-excluded population of 2369 parents and 644368 bottom orbits, never the complete named levels
